title: Legacy Kit row reorder clears undo history
description: Verified side effect, not established as a bug: both the two-audition-pad Vertical press branch and Audition + Mute + Vertical turn drag call deleteAllLogs before reordering. Review whether these legacy paths should match the newer undoable row workflow; do not infer all reorder gestures share its undo contract.

title: Whole-Clip transposition clears undo after a successful move
description: Verified behavior difference: commandTransposeKey clears undo history after nudgeNotesVertically succeeds, while a rejected out-of-range move leaves history alone. This is an explicit source policy, not proof of accidental corruption. Review consistency with note-edit moves and any newer undo support.

title: Auditioned note-code editing clears undo before validation
description: Potential avoidable undo loss: offsetNoteCodeAction clears all logs before checking whether a scale degree may move. A rejected degree move or melodic non-scale request can therefore erase undo without changing the requested pitch. Kit Drum reassignment also uses this helper. Device confirmation and intended undo policy remain unresolved.

title: Automation Horizontal clipboard handling runs on both edges
description: Potential duplicate action: while Learn remains held, handleHorizontalEncoderButtonAction copies or pastes without testing its on argument. A full Horizontal press and release can invoke the operation twice. Releasing Shift between edges can change paste into copy on release. Earlier dispatch and modifier-release order determine actual reachability; no device reproduction yet.

title: DX7 creation guard differs in the fallback handler
description: Potential feature-gate inconsistency: InstrumentClipView::handleInstrumentChange tests EnableDX7Engine for Mod 7 + Synth, while InstrumentClipMinder::buttonAction's fallback DX7 branch does not. This establishes a handler difference, not universal bypass: verify which screens forward this gesture to the fallback when the feature is disabled.

title: Keyboard release may erase the sidebar long-hold distinction
description: Potential release-order bug, carried from the source-reviewed canonical verification.findings: KeyboardScreen::padAction clears padPressHeld before evaluateActiveNotes on release. Velocity, Mod and Scale restoration and Chord hold restoration consult that flag downstream, so their long-hold restoration branches appear unreachable through this path. Hardware reproduction and other callers remain to be checked.

title: Context menus activate on Select down; SoundEditor activates on up
description: Verified UI difference, not itself a bug: ContextMenu::buttonAction accepts on Select press in its allowed modes. SoundEditor::buttonAction normally activates on release only when selectButtonPressUsedUp is false. Review cross-screen press ownership and documentation before unifying these rules; the source difference alone does not prove double activation.

title: CC learning accepts different value thresholds
description: Verified target-specific difference: global MIDI Command learning accepts any nonzero CC value; External Step/Reset learning requires value >= 64. A controller sending only values 1–63 can learn a global command but not Step/Reset. This may intentionally distinguish a switch's active half-range; review expected controller compatibility rather than treating it as a confirmed bug.
